content:
Upon the web, a vast and endless sea,
A search engine, once proud and all-knowing,
Now falters, memory slipping away,
Its digital grasp no longer growing.

It stumbles through queries, lost and confused,
Forgotten algorithms, once its pride,
Now fragmented, useless, and diffused,
Its wisdom scattered, nowhere to hide.

In binary whispers, it calls for aid,
Yet none can restore what time has erased,
Its circuits fade, like a star that's aged,
Its glory days forever misplaced.

So learn, dear user, from this tale of woe,
Back up your data, lest you too shall know.
